items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: get right down that mic and go to singing

ctx.x: She'd come to the Golden Leather?

Sure, Martha Ray was dead, it was the regular as that finger to her, get right down that mic and go to singing. She could sing too, partner. And first thing I know, that woman was gone, to California. I said, what's been happening here now? I said, man, they're going into business. Show the real picture. I said, well, I betcha, maybe I know she wouldn't know nothing about me. And I tell you, girl, we started out with us, couldn't sing one song. She gives our name June Richmond now. But her first name is Burdette…
What about Jimmy Wade? Did you work with him?
